dream_synopsis: Embry dreams of a Yale room where every sentence she speaks splits into two columns: what she said and what Kai, James, and the room itself are allowed to believe. The dream heightens her self-audit into a shifting tribunal of missed calls, withheld context, and unanswered repair, with precision becoming both a shield and a confession she cannot send.

panels.action: Embry opens a locked file that expands into two tall luminous columns labeled WHAT I SAID and WHAT I MADE POSSIBLE TO BELIEVE; a missed Kai call pulses between the columns like a warning light.
panels.setting: A Yale dorm-like room fused with an audit file interface; the family afghan hangs over a chair, and a SPARTA badge rests half-hidden in an open drawer.
panels.shot: Tight frontal shot of Embry in the foreground, face fully visible, lit by a laptop glow; Kai appears behind her as a dim reflection in the dark screen.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry stares directly toward the viewer, one hand on the laptop, while Kai’s reflected face hovers over the blank space where an answer should be typed.

panels.action: Kai asks without sound, and Embry’s literal answer appears as clean white text, but a larger gray shadow-text forms behind it, implying reassurance she has not earned.
panels.setting: A dream-version of Yale hallway where the walls are built from repeated phrases: NOTHING HAS HAPPENED WITH ANYONE and IS THERE SOMEONE THERE YOU GO TO INSTEAD OF ME?
panels.shot: Medium close-up with Embry foregrounded and face visible in profile-to-camera; Kai stands opposite her across a narrow corridor made of text lines.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry’s face is tense and brightly visible as the words leave her mouth; Kai, clearly visible at the far end of the text corridor, goes still and quiet.

panels.action: Embry tells James, “I watched Kai’s call end before I started the rerun,” and James’s reply, “That is different from not noticing,” settles into the second column like evidence.
panels.setting: A quiet dream-walk path that loops through the Yale room, with the afghan draped like a path marker and the laptop columns following overhead.
panels.shot: Three-quarter close-up of Embry in the foreground, face visible and turned toward James; Kai appears in the background as a fading call window on a floating phone screen.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry’s face is exposed and conflicted in the foreground; James stands beside her as a calm listener, while Kai’s unanswered call glows behind them, smaller but impossible to erase.

panels.action: Embry reaches toward a SEND button that keeps changing into CLOSE; the two columns merge into one question about repair, then lock before she can answer it.
panels.mood: unresolved, longing, heavy with withheld repair
panels.setting: The Yale room becomes a sealed archive: the laptop, SPARTA badge, afghan, missed call, and audit headers orbit a single unsent file.
panels.shot: Centered close-up of Embry in the foreground, face fully visible; Kai and James stand on opposite sides behind her, partially separated by the two glowing columns.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry faces forward with tearful concentration, hand suspended above the shifting button; Kai watches from one side in silence, James from the other with unreadable concern.
